filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Sun Oct 25 – Mon Oct 26 PT

market_briefing.lede: Systems of record are turning their apps into back ends that agents call from wherever work starts, with permissions and approvals enforced underneath.

bullets.text: Oracle's new Fusion Companion selects and coordinates the transactions, workflows, approvals, agents and agentic applications needed for a request, and users can reach it from ChatGPT as well as Oracle's own Agentic Home.

Oracle also shipped 25 Fusion Claw-powered agentic applications across ERP, HCM, supply chain and CX, including CPQ configuration migration and service health checks, framed as a "system of outcomes" where people set objectives and authority.

biggest_ai_news.title: Anthropic files S-1 for Nasdaq IPO
biggest_ai_news.body: Anthropic publicly filed its S-1 on Oct 26 to list Class A shares on Nasdaq as ANT; share count and price range are not yet set. CNBC reports an $80.7B first-half loss and $6.2B of debt, with data-center moratoriums flagged as a key risk.

what_changed.title: Anthropic files its S-1
what_changed.body: NEW. Oct 26, 2026: Anthropic, PBC filed a Form S-1 for a proposed IPO of Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol ANT. Share count and price range are not yet set. Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley are named for prospectus requests.

what_changed.title: Oracle announces Fusion Companion and Fusion Agentic Home
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Oct 26, Oracle AI World, Las Vegas: Companion is reachable through supported AI tools such as ChatGPT, and through Oracle Fusion Agentic Home. It coordinates actions across Fusion and other enterprise systems within existing identity, permissions and approval controls.

what_changed.title: Oracle makes 25 Claw-powered Agentic Applications available
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Oct 26: 25 applications across Fusion ERP, HCM, SCM and CX. Named examples include Ledger, Procurement Spend, CPQ Test-to-Production Setup & Configuration Migration, Service Health Check and Strategic Field Demand Planning.

language_pulse.gloss: Oracle's framing for Fusion Agentic Applications: people define the objectives, authority and accountability, and the applications coordinate the work to an outcome (Oct 26).
Oracle's term for what Fusion Claw adds to that runtime: longer-running specialist work with more autonomy inside the controls the organization already set (Oct 26).
Oracle's name for Fusion Companion, the layer that executes work from AI clients such as ChatGPT while Fusion keeps permissions and approvals (Oct 26).
